labels: 1 if OAE Yield(Y)>Yield(Y-1);0 if less; exact equality excluded
observations: Y-1 only, before issue; no current-year weather
training_labels: <= prediction_year-2; conservative proxy, not certified publication evidence
first_outer_family_freeze: Family and feature group from first own Inner only, before any binary Outer scores. Later Inner chooses preset inside frozen family/group.
inner: latest up to3 complete eligible years<=outer-2 with >=8 training rows; minimum2 inner years
tie_policy: within0.02 best aggregate MacroF1: lower year F1 SD, fewer features, simpler family, unweighted, ID
class_weights: train-only N/(2*class_count), weight toggle only; no SMOTE
regression: signed YoY pct predicted directly, sign threshold0 fixed, no clamp and no inference use of YieldY-1
capacity: direct depth2/160trees (RF150),LogisticC0.1; two weight presets. Ridgealpha10/100; CatRegdepth2/3; seed42 CPU2
ndvi: Landsat8 only >=6 real months; matched four-province complete-year cohort. Missing raw months not filled.
soil_gis: context only excluded due historical map hindsight
anomaly: train-only per-province historical means; rain percent anomaly
readiness_gate: descriptive only: candidate MacroF1 and accuracy beat both baselines; at least3/4 province F1 wins and >=4/6 year accuracy wins vs previous direction; never sufficient for operational/PIT approval
